etymologies.etymologyHTML: Borrowed from Medieval Latin pūnctuālis (“relating to a point”), from Late Latin pūnctus (“point”) + -ālis (adjective suffix).

definitions.definition: (of an event) Happening at the appointed time
(of a person) Acting at the appointed time
(chiefly mathematics) Existing as a point or series of points
(linguistics) Expressing momentary action that has no duration
